fields.title: Modification
fields.description: Defines the action to be performed on the selected columns. The date can be changed, appended, or removed, with different columns being eligible for each action. For example, only time columns can have date appended, while local date&time columns can only be modified or have their date component removed.

fields.title: Date
fields.description: The date to use when changing the date of date&time columns or appending a date to time columns.

fields.title: Time zone
fields.description: The time zone to use when appending a date to time columns.

fields.title: Date&time columns
fields.description: The date&time columns whose values are modified.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Output columns
fields.description: Depending on this setting, the output columns will either replace the modified columns, or be appended to the table with a suffix.

fields.title: Output column suffix
fields.description: The suffix to append to the column names of the new columns.
